Consult Summary:
- Working diagnosis: Chronic fatigue with diffuse myalgias/aches for about six weeks, with a transient rash in February; Lyme disease considered; plan to obtain baseline labs and Lyme serology with follow-up by phone.

History:
- Presenting complaint: Six weeks of aching all over with fatigue and lower energy; decreased appetite; otherwise no prominent weight change, no chest symptoms, no persistent cold symptoms, and no significant abdominal or urinary symptoms.
- Onset/duration: Symptoms began in late January/February after a holiday in the United States; fatigue ongoing for about six weeks as of April; transient rash appeared end February and resolved after ~two weeks.
- Symptom progression: Fatigue and aches persistent since onset; fatigue described as lower energy and tiredness at work; exercise limited; appetite slightly reduced with effort to finish meals.
- Associated symptoms: Transient rash on the calf (end of February) that faded after a couple of weeks; sore throat around the time of feverish feeling; no headaches, blurred vision, tingling, or numbness reported.
- Exposures/initiating factors: Recently returned from holiday in the United States; significant walking/hiking; no clear infection reported during holiday; no recalled insect bites.
- Respiratory/other systems: No shortness of breath, chest pain, cough; no diarrhea or vomiting; no urinary changes; no rashes elsewhere; no joint swelling reported beyond aching shoulders, back, hips, and knees.
- Mental health/function: Generally good mental health currently; some previous stress noted but not active.
- Sleep: Not specifically described.
- Past Medical History: Asthma and hay fever.
- Medications: Inhaler described as a preventative (controller) for asthma; patient states both “not used” and “used daily morning and night” in conflicting statements; also takes an antihistamine (OTC) with dosing not documented.
- Allergies: Not documented.
- Social History: Lives with wife; employed at a health technology company; alcohol use: occasionally; smoking status not documented; no illicit drug use reported. No financial or other lifestyle factors noted.
- Family History: Not mentioned.
